from itertools import product
# regions over sets M,C,T,L -> each region occupied or not
regs=list(product([0,1],repeat=4))
res1=True; res2=True; found=False
for occ in product([0,1],repeat=16):
    R=[r for r,o in zip(regs,occ) if o]
    M=lambda r:r[0];C=lambda r:r[1];T=lambda r:r[2];L=lambda r:r[3]
    if any(M(r) and C(r) for r in R): continue
    if not any(C(r) and T(r) for r in R): continue
    if not any(T(r) and L(r) for r in R): continue
    found=True
    if not any(C(r) and L(r) for r in R): res1=False
    if all(M(r) for r in R if T(r)): res2=False
assert found
verdict={(False,False):'A',(False,True):'B',(True,True):'C',(True,False):'D'}[(res1,res2)]
assert verdict=='B'
for k in 'ACD': assert verdict!=k
